mentions.note: second in Surrey County Youth 200 metres
runner-up in Youth 100; led the 200m until the final metres

photos.c: FRONT COVER:(Ron Linstead) Martin Bloice (4) inches ahead of Gerry Quarry (Tulse Hill School) to win the Surrey County Youth 200 metres title in 23.2 which, with his brilliant 51.3 win in the 400 metres, must have vied for the most impressive double of the Championships.
